edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner directly from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner and forwards funds to owner.
transfer debits the caller balance keyed by msg.sender.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer relies on safeSub for the sender debit.
transfer relies on safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balances and allowance deduction.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient.
safeAdd performs the checked addition a + b.
safeSub performs the guarded subtraction a - b.
safeMul performs the checked multiplication a * b.
safeDiv performs the guarded division a / b.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller identity.
transferFrom moves value between balances entries.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in the allowed mapping.
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender as the owner key.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner and callback argument.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied spender contract.
External call executes after the allowed mapping is written, enabling inconsistent state on re-entry.
The spender contract can call back into approveAndCall or other token functions during receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs a low-level external token transfer call.
The arbitrary token contract can re-enter the token during the external transfer.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf indexes the balances mapping with tokenOwner.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
allowance indexes allowed with tokenOwner.
allowance indexes allowed with spender.
allowance reads from the allowed mapping.
Constructor assigns the fixed total supply.
Constructor pre-mints the supply to the deployer address in balances.
